extension.summary: Everyone in the household keeps their own watch history, through your own CrossWatch.
extension.description: CrossWatch (crosswatch.app) is a free, self-hosted app that keeps watch history, ratings and playback progress in sync between media servers such as Plex, Jellyfin and Emby and trackers such as Trakt and Simkl, with a profile per person. This add-on needs a running CrossWatch on your network.[CR][CR]It reports what plays in Kodi, and who is watching, so each person's history reaches their own accounts. The viewer is worked out from smart playlist membership, the active Kodi profile, or a question when playback stops, remembered per show. Optionally, rate an episode or film after watching it.[CR][CR]Maintained by Rouzax, not by the CrossWatch project: report add-on problems on GitHub (github.com/crosswatch-app/kodi-addon).
extension.news: v1.0.1 (2026-10-20) - Stream addresses are cleaned more thoroughly: access tokens and passwords in them no longer reach CrossWatch or the log. - A watch is no longer lost when a proxy in front of CrossWatch shows a login or maintenance page; it is sent later. - A profile renamed in CrossWatch while something plays now also applies to that watch. - A mistyped port in the CrossWatch address shows a clear message instead of failing. - Changes in Viewers are no longer lost if CrossWatch renames someone at the same moment.
